_pack: The only line that makes this a warehouse mesh. Everything else here is what any project would write. Delete this line and validation fails on four types, three predicates and two reason codes — which is how you can tell the pack is doing the work rather than decorating the config.
_bundles: `knowledge` is an IN-PLACE bundle: those files carry their own frontmatter, so they are the concepts and nothing mirrors them. It sits outside `build.root` and is registered here by path, which is the only way an in-place bundle becomes visible to the validator.
